mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xw_task_hit (task_id, skill_name, hit_type, platform, title, summary, dedupe_key, payload_json, source_tool, tool_event_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{skillName}, #{hitType}, #{platform}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{dedupeKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{sourceTool}, #{toolEventId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE skill_name = IFNULL(#{skillName}, skill_name), hit_type = #{hitType}, platform = #{platform}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, payload_json = #{payloadJson}, source_tool = #{sourceTool}, tool_event_id = IFNULL(#{toolEventId}, tool_event_id), updated_at = NOW()
